card.name: Modifiers right before outcome or survival
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'outcome(s)' or 'survival', such as better, improved, clinical, optimal or long-term, in prognosis and treatment-result text.

modes.label: Adjective before outcomes
modes.description: An adjective like better, improved or clinical sits right before the word outcome(s).
modes.example: have<< better>> outcomes if their transplant was not performed at

modes.label: Before survival or prognosis
modes.description: A modifier or possessive precedes survival or prognosis wording.
modes.example: the lack of evidence of<< improved>> survival for any antiarrhythmic drug

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word outcome or outcomes next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'outcome' or 'survival' is expected, as in 'better ___' or 'improved ___'.
